## Overview

Lets MiniMax M3.1's NVFP4 index cache (vllm-project/vllm#64111) be sharded over TP ranks with indexer CP, which vllm-project/vllm#61929 and vllm-project/vllm#63671 support only for FP8. Depends on vllm-project/vllm#63671 (itself on vllm-project/vllm#61929): only 7 commits are new here ([this PR's commits](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/64631/files/a76900d6eee737506a7e7d7e2d540a3171c8cbe8..d5a53c38ed44fb5e19494d665abe5f33482a9afb)), and the branch also merges #63671's latest head and main. Like vllm-project/vllm#61929, it needs vllm-project/MSA#46 (`FMHA_SM100_SRC_DIR`) until the MSA pin moves past it.

Not a duplicate: no open PR shards the NVFP4 index cache. vllm-project/vllm#59980 (M3, FP8) and vllm-project/vllm#64448 (ROCm) split decode scoring over a replicated cache, as main's opt-in `indexer_decode_cp` does.

## Claims

- With `--attention-config '{"indexer_kv_dtype":"nvfp4","indexer_cache_sharding":"on"}'` (off by default), each TP rank stores only its rows of every NVFP4 index page: 36 B instead of 72 B per token per sparse layer at TP2, 18 B at TP4. Supported: TP2 and TP4 at `--block-size 128` (256 cannot serve yet, see below), `indexer_prefill_cp='gather'`.
- Decode rounds index-K as the stock Q8KV4 decode indexer does on each arch (to e4m3 on SM100/SM103, exact on SM107), so the sharded CuTe scorer's page scores match the stock kernel's up to FP32 summation order.
- At P256/TP2 with eight-query decode (DSpark k=7), a rank's shard pages are stock NVFP4 pages, so decode scores them with the stock Q8KV4 decode indexer instead. On GB200 and GB300 that makes the per-layer decode indexer 1.35-1.4x faster than with the CuTe scorer at 16 requests and 1.6x faster at 64 (see Validation), and its scores are bitwise identical to the stock scores of the unsharded pages. `VLLM_MINIMAX_M3_ICP_Q8KV4_DECODE=0` keeps the CuTe scorer. Serving cannot reach this path yet, so only kernel tests cover it: at `--block-size 256`, vllm-project/vllm#63671 lets NVFP4 main attention keep 256-token pages, but vllm-project/MSA#46's Q8KV4 prefill accepts only 128-token pages (found by reading the code, not run).
- The gather prefill stages each rank's shard pages to FP8 with the stock NVFP4 prefill's kernel, then all-gathers them.
- End to end on GB300 at TP2 and `--block-size 128` (so the CuTe scorer), one 1-hour agentic run at concurrency 16 per variant: sharding gives 9.8% more KV tokens at the same prefix-cache hit rate, but ITL rises 25% and throughput falls 2%. An MRCR accuracy check is inconclusive: pooled −1.1 points (95% CI −2.2 to +0.1). See Validation.
- With sharding off, behavior is unchanged apart from the shared paths listed under Details.

## Validation

```
pytest tests/kernels/attention/test_minimax_m3.py
pytest tests/kernels/attention/test_minimax_m3_indexer_prefill_sharded.py
pytest tests/distributed/test_minimax_m3_indexer_sharding.py  # 4 GPUs: TP2, TP4
pytest tests/kernels/test_fused_minimax_m3_qknorm_rope_kv_insert.py  # needs a source build
```

These ran before the branch merged main `3d23773f1`, with vllm-project/MSA#46 (`f380d0e`) and the branch's Python, either over a prebuilt vLLM ("prebuilt") or over the CUDA 13.4 nightly image for main `3966924d5` with `_C_stable_libtorch` rebuilt from the branch ("image"):

| Arch | Base | Build | Tests | Passed | Skipped | Failed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SM100, SM103 | #63671 at `a76900d6e` | image | `test_fused_minimax_m3_qknorm_rope_kv_insert.py` | 168 | 0 | 0 |
| SM100, SM103 | #63671 at `a76900d6e` | image | `test_minimax_m3.py -k 'sharded or q8kv4 or gather_nvfp4'` | 335 | 0 | 8 (a) |
| SM100, SM103 | #63671 at `a76900d6e` | prebuilt | `test_minimax_m3.py -k 'sharded or q8kv4 or gather_nvfp4 or gather_prefill_pages or sharding_policy'` | 334 | 6 | 8 (a) |
| SM100, SM103 | #63671 at `54a5c7113` | prebuilt | same | 342 | 6 | 0 |
| SM107 | #63671 at `54a5c7113` | prebuilt | `test_minimax_m3.py` | 481 | 55 | 14 (b) |
| SM107 | #63671 at `54a5c7113` | prebuilt | `test_minimax_m3_indexer_prefill_sharded.py` | 164 | 0 | 0 |
| SM107 | #63671 at `54a5c7113` | prebuilt | `test_minimax_m3_indexer_sharding.py` | 2 | 0 | 0 |

(a) `test_sharded_candidate_merge_deduplicates_and_forces`, from vllm-project/vllm#61929's `dc68fa728` (its test indexed a CPU tensor with a CUDA mask), not this PR. #63671's `9fcb12446`, which the branch now merges, fixes the test.
(b) main's stock NVFP4 indexer tests (`test_nvfp4_indexer_impl_matches_reference`, `test_nvfp4_indexer_decode_cuda_graph_replay`), which fail the same way without this PR: their reference rounds K to e4m3, which the stock kernel does not on SM107.
The 6 prebuilt skips on SM100/SM103 are the QMUL4 gather variants, which that Triton cannot build; they run and pass in the image.

Decode indexer time per layer and rank in µs (scoring, plus candidate publish and merge for ICP), at TP2, `--block-size 256` and eight queries per request:

| GPU | Requests | Context | Replicated stock | ICP, CuTe scorer | ICP, stock Q8KV4 scorer |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GB200 | 16 | 128K | 44.1 | 78.0 | 57.6 |
| GB200 | 16 | 168K | 53.7 | 88.3 | 63.7 |
| GB200 | 64 | 128K | 127.6 | 206.9 | 125.1 |
| GB200 | 64 | 168K | 154.1 | 239.8 | 147.6 |
| GB300 | 16 | 128K | 44.6 | 78.2 | 57.8 |
| GB300 | 16 | 168K | 53.1 | 88.7 | 65.7 |
| GB300 | 64 | 128K | 125.9 | 207.2 | 125.4 |
| GB300 | 64 | 168K | 159.2 | 240.0 | 147.9 |

These come from one GPU with both ranks simulated: each kernel runs as its own CUDA graph with a cold L2, and each time is the median of 200 runs, averaged over two runs that agreed within 2%. NVLink latency and rank skew are not modeled, and timing ICP's three graphs separately adds a few µs against the stock path's one.

The new >65535-page gather test fails on the previous kernel (`RuntimeError: Triton Error [CUDA]: invalid argument`) and passes with this PR.

**End to end.** MiniMax-M3.1-Flash on GB300 in the image above, one TP2 server per run: `--block-size 128`, NVFP4 KV and index cache, DSpark k=7, the V2 model runner, `indexer_prefill_cp='gather'`, and sharding off or on. "On" decodes with the CuTe scorer (P128 shards are not stock pages) and, unlike "off", skips the fused MXFP8 QKV epilogue. Each server's log shows the expected mode, and none logged a traceback or error.

Performance, from one 1-hour run per variant of InferenceX's agentic coding trace (AgentX, thinking on) at concurrency 16, with synthetic draft acceptance 4.04:

| | Off | On | On/off |
|---|---|---|---|
| KV cache size (tokens) | 5,492,736 | 6,030,720 | 1.098 |
| Total throughput (tok/s/GPU) | 55,344 | 54,171 | 0.979 |
| ITL mean / P90 (ms) | 3.82 / 5.70 | 4.77 / 7.17 | 1.25 / 1.26 |
| TTFT mean / P90 (ms) | 753 / 1,554 | 771 / 1,504 | 1.02 / 0.97 |
| Request latency P90 (s) | 9.69 | 11.44 | 1.18 |
| Prompt tokens read from the prefix cache | 97.20% | 97.26% | |

The prefix-cache hit rate is the same in both runs, so this workload gains nothing from the extra capacity. In both runs the same 3 requests (of 2,578 and 2,535 measured) returned no `content` text, which the client counts as errors.

Accuracy, from MRCR with `tests/evals/mrcr`'s loader and scorer on openai/mrcr, at temperature 0, `max_tokens` 4096 and real draft verification, on the same samples in both variants:

| Samples | Prompt tokens | Off | On | On − off (95% CI) | Identical responses |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 600 (16-64K bins, concurrency 8) | 16-65K | 0.9889 | 0.9850 | −0.0040 (−0.0122, +0.0038) | 84% |
| 150 (128-256K bin, concurrency 4) | 133-260K | 0.9328 | 0.8956 | −0.0372 (−0.0868, +0.0105) | 69% |
| 750 pooled | | 0.9777 | 0.9671 | −0.0106 (−0.0225, +0.0008) | 81% |

No difference is significant (pooled sign test p = 0.12: 63 samples better, 78 worse), but the interval does not exclude a 2-point drop, so the check is inconclusive. In the long arm, 12 samples hit the 4096-token limit in only one variant (8 with sharding on, 4 with it off). They make up 90% of that arm's difference; the other 138 differ by −0.004.

Not run yet, so this stays a draft:
- serving at `--block-size 256` (blocked, see Claims) and at TP4, and repeats of the single end-to-end runs above;
- the GPU tests and end-to-end runs above, repeated since the merge of main `3d23773f1`;
- in CI: the multi-GPU test file has no CI step, and CI covers SM100 only.

## Details

- **Motivation:** KV capacity. Without sharding every rank stores the whole NVFP4 index cache; sharded, TP2 halves and TP4 quarters it, and the freed memory goes to KV tokens.
- **Tradeoffs:**
  - The gather prefill all-gathers FP8 rows (128 B rather than 72 B per token), and like the FP8 gather of vllm-project/vllm#61929 it neither chunks nor reserves its per-layer transient. Main's extensible KV cache, on by default with the V2 runner, now leaves less free memory for that transient than the old 0.92 `gpu_memory_utilization` default did.
  - A sharded cache disables the fused MXFP8 QKV epilogue, which writes whole NVFP4 index pages.
  - Sharded prefill ranks pages with MSA's fmha OnlyScore and `sparse_topk_select` instead of the stock Q8KV8 prefill indexer, so its selection can differ from the replicated path at exact ties.
- **Why a second decode scorer:** only at P256/TP2 is a rank's shard a whole stock NVFP4 page, so only there can the stock Q8KV4 decode indexer, which already serves the replicated cache, score it. It needs full eight-query tiles, because the candidate publish reads contiguous `[tokens, heads, columns]` scores. Every other shape keeps the CuTe scorer.
- **Policy:** at TP4, indexer CP yields to the opt-in `indexer_decode_cp`, which keeps a replicated cache. `local_score` prefill and KV connectors (including CPU offload) are not supported with NVFP4 sharding yet. `dspark` is now accepted for sharding.
- **Shared paths:** the C++ insert's `idx_block_size` runs on every M3.1 deployment; the NVFP4 gather kernel now puts pages on grid x, since one sharded staging call can exceed grid y's 65,535 limit, and main's unsharded prefill uses that kernel too; vllm-project/vllm#61929's FP8 scorer epilogue is factored into fold/store helpers shared with the NVFP4 kernel; the Q8KV4 path calls MSA's private `_run_scores`, as main's decode CP does.

@@ -516,3 +516,39 @@ If you observe that GPU utilization is lower than expected, CPU contention may b
 vLLM supports multiple attention backends optimized for different hardware and use cases. The backend is automatically selected based on your GPU architecture, model type, and configuration, but you can also manually specify one for optimal performance.
 
 For detailed information on available backends, their feature support, and how to configure them, see the [Attention Backend Feature Support](../design/attention_backends.md) documentation.
+
+## MiniMax M3 indexer context parallelism
+
+With `--attention-config '{"indexer_kv_dtype":"fp8","indexer_cache_sharding":"on"}'`, the MSA backend
+can shard FP8 index K over single-node NVLink TP2 or TP4 with 128-token pages.
+Prefill defaults to gathering index K and scoring the local query heads.
+To score local K and exchange Top16 candidates instead, use
+`--attention-config '{"indexer_kv_dtype":"fp8","indexer_cache_sharding":"on","indexer_prefill_cp":"local_score"}'`.
+Set `indexer_prefill_cp` to `gather` for the comparison path on the same cache layout.
+The experimental `local_score_unified` mode also includes decode queries in the
+local-score exchange during mixed batches; pure decode keeps its existing path.
+All modes preserve logical 128-token block IDs and main attention.
+Local prefill scores bounded query chunks and accumulates candidates
+in reusable buffers for one NCCL exchange per layer.
+There is no automatic path selection; compare full-model performance for your workload.
+
+With an NVFP4 main KV cache, `--block-size 256` uses contiguous index-K
+shards within each physical page. Logical ranking blocks remain 128 tokens:
+TP2 owns a full block per rank, while TP4 owns half a block. Candidate exchange
+is still required to route results to the query-head owners. Page size and
+layout are fixed at startup; `gather` and `local_score` share that layout.
+P256 requires the corresponding MSA P256 NVFP4 kernel support.
+
+An NVFP4 index cache (MiniMax-M3.1) shards the same way with
+`--attention-config '{"indexer_kv_dtype":"nvfp4","indexer_cache_sharding":"on"}'`.
+Decode scores each rank's NVFP4 rows directly. The `gather` prefill, the only
+prefill mode it supports, dequantizes each rank's shard pages to FP8 as the
+unsharded NVFP4 prefill does and then all-gathers them, so it moves FP8 rather
+than NVFP4 bytes over NVLink. Other prefill modes, or `indexer_decode_cp` at
+TP4, keep a replicated NVFP4 index cache and log why.
+At TP2 with `--block-size 256`, each rank's half of a page is itself a stock
+128-row NVFP4 index page, so decode with eight queries per request (seven
+speculative tokens) scores it with the unsharded indexer's MSA Q8KV4 kernel
+over all index heads, with the same numerics. Other query lengths, TP sizes
+and page sizes use the sharded scorer; set
+`VLLM_MINIMAX_M3_ICP_Q8KV4_DECODE=0` to use it everywhere.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+import faulthandler
+from copy import copy
+
+import pytest
+import ray
+import torch
+
+from tests.v1.attention.utils import (
+    BatchSpec,
+    create_common_attn_metadata,
+    create_vllm_config,
+)
+from vllm.config import (
+    AttentionConfig,
+    CompilationConfig,
+    CUDAGraphMode,
+    KVTransferConfig,
+    SchedulerConfig,
+    SpeculativeConfig,
+    set_current_vllm_config,
+)
+from vllm.forward_context import set_forward_context
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+from ..utils import init_test_distributed_environment, multi_process_parallel
+
+PREFILL_CHUNK_SIZE = 1024
+PREFILL_SCORE_BYTES = 32 << 20
+
+
+def _nvfp4_rows_to_fp8(codes: torch.Tensor, scales: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """e4m3 ``[..., 128]`` rows: e2m1 * scale, clamped and rounded once."""
+    values = torch.tensor((0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 6.0), device=codes.device)
+    nibbles = torch.stack((codes & 15, codes >> 4), -1).flatten(-2).long()
+    # Multiply rather than negate so that code 8 stays -0.
+    k = values[nibbles & 7] * torch.where(nibbles >= 8, -1.0, 1.0)
+    k = k.unflatten(-1, (8, 16)) * scales.float()[..., None]
+    return k.flatten(-2).clamp(-448.0, 448.0).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+
+
+@ray.remote(num_gpus=1, max_calls=1)
+def _indexer_sharding(monkeypatch, tp_size, pp_size, rank, distributed_init_port):
+    from vllm.distributed.parallel_state import get_tp_group
+    from vllm.models.minimax_m3.nvidia import indexer_msa as msa
+
+    with monkeypatch.context() as m:
+        m.delenv("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES", raising=False)
+        m.setattr(msa, "PREFILL_FMHA_CHUNK_SIZE", PREFILL_CHUNK_SIZE)
+        device = torch.device(f"cuda:{rank}")
+        torch.accelerator.set_device_index(device)
+        config = create_vllm_config(
+            model_name="Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B",
+            tensor_parallel_size=tp_size,
+            block_size=128,
+            max_model_len=4096,
+            max_num_seqs=4,
+            max_num_batched_tokens=1536,
+            hf_config_override={
+                "sparse_attention_config": {
+                    "sparse_num_index_heads": 4,
+                    "sparse_index_dim": 128,
+                }
+            },
+        )
+        config.speculative_config = SpeculativeConfig(
+            method="ngram", num_speculative_tokens=7
+        )
+        config.attention_config.indexer_cache_sharding = "on"
+        with set_current_vllm_config(config):
+            init_test_distributed_environment(
+                tp_size, pp_size, rank, distributed_init_port
+            )
+            _check_initialization_fallback(config, device, rank)
+            assert msa.resolve_index_k_shard(config, 4, "fp8", 16) == tp_size
+            comm = msa.get_comm()
+            assert comm is not None
+            assert comm.scores.shape == (comm.max_decode_tokens, 4, 32)
+            for page_size in (128, 256):
+                config.cache_config.block_size = page_size
+                comm = msa.get_comm(config, 4)
+                assert comm is not None
+                _check_indexer_forwards(config, device, rank, comm)
+            config.cache_config.block_size = 128
+            _check_sharding_policy(config, comm)
+        get_tp_group().barrier()
+
+
+def _check_initialization_fallback(config, device, rank):
+    import torch.distributed._symmetric_memory as symm_mem
+
+    from vllm.models.minimax_m3.nvidia import indexer_msa as msa
+
+    for name, value in (("enable_dbo", True), ("ubatch_size", 2)):
+        with pytest.MonkeyPatch.context() as m:
+            m.setattr(config.parallel_config, name, value)
+            assert msa.resolve_index_k_shard(config, 4, "fp8", 16) == 1
+            assert msa.get_comm() is None
+            assert not msa._COMM_FAILED
+
+    for failure in (
+        "topology",
+        "recv_allocation",
+    ):
+        with pytest.MonkeyPatch.context() as m:
+            m.setattr(msa, "_COMM", None)
+            m.setattr(msa, "_COMM_FAILED", False)
+            injected = False
+
+            def fail_allocation(*args, **kwargs):
+                nonlocal injected
+                injected = True
+                raise RuntimeError("injected indexer allocation failure")
+
+            def fail_topology(_):
+                nonlocal injected
+                injected = True
+                return False
+
+            if rank == 1:
+                if failure == "topology":
+                    m.setattr(current_platform, "is_fully_connected", fail_topology)
+                else:
+                    m.setattr(symm_mem, "empty", fail_allocation)
+
+            # A rank stranded in rendezvous or GPU polling cannot raise a Python
+            # timeout. Exit that worker so Ray reports failure and stops peers.
+            faulthandler.dump_traceback_later(90, exit=True)
+            try:
+                shard = msa.resolve_index_k_shard(config, 4, "fp8", 16)
+                assert injected == (rank == 1)
+                assert shard == 1
+                assert msa.get_comm() is None
+                assert msa._COMM_FAILED
+            finally:
+                faulthandler.cancel_dump_traceback_later()
+
+
+def _check_indexer_forwards(config, device, rank, comm):
+    from vllm.models.minimax_m3.nvidia import indexer_msa as msa
+
+    torch.manual_seed(123)
+    world = comm.world
+    page_size = config.cache_config.block_size
+    local_heads = 4 // world
+    # Five layers exercise all three receive slot sets, including wrap across
+    # steps. Keep the actual production communication objects and dispatch.
+    comm.num_layers = 0
+    layers = []
+    for sharded in (False, True):
+        layers.append(
+            [
+                msa.MiniMaxM3IndexerMSAImpl(
+                    num_kv_heads=local_heads,
+                    scale=128**-0.5,
+                    topk_blocks=16,
+                    sparse_block_size=128,
+                    num_index_heads=local_heads,
+                    index_head_dim=128,
+                    init_blocks=1,
+                    local_blocks=1,
+                    prefix=f"indexer_p{page_size}_{sharded}_{layer}",
+                    cache_config=config.cache_config,
+                    indexer_kv_dtype="fp8",
+                    index_k_shard=world if sharded else 1,
+                    topk_indices_buffer=torch.empty(
+                        (1536, local_heads, 16), dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+                    ),
+                )
+                for layer in range(5)
+            ]
+        )
+    assert [impl.index_k_ordinal for impl in layers[1]] == list(range(5))
+    assert all(impl.index_k_comm is comm for impl in layers[1])
+    builders = []
+    for impls, prefill_mode in (
+        (layers[0], "gather"),
+        (layers[1], "gather"),
+        (layers[1], "local_score"),
+        (layers[1], "local_score_unified"),
+    ):
+        with pytest.MonkeyPatch.context() as patch:
+            patch.setattr(config.attention_config, "indexer_prefill_cp", prefill_mode)
+            builders.append(
+                msa.MiniMaxM3IndexerMSAMetadataBuilder(
+                    impls[0].index_cache.get_kv_cache_spec(config),
+                    [impl.index_cache.prefix for impl in impls],
+                    config,
+                    device,
+                )
+            )
+    assert all(builder.unified_scores_buffer is not None for builder in builders[:2])
+    assert all(builder.unified_scores_buffer is None for builder in builders[2:])
+    prefill_storage = [
+        (
+            builder.prefill_scores_buffer.data_ptr(),
+            builder.prefill_candidates_buffer.data_ptr(),
+        )
+        for builder in builders[2:]
+    ]
+
+    active_layers = 5
+
+    def local_shard(cache):
+        if page_size == 256:
+            rows = page_size // world
+            return cache[:, rank * rows : (rank + 1) * rows]
+        return cache[:, rank::world]
+
+    def run(sharded, metadata, queries):
+        impls = layers[sharded][:active_layers]
+        md = {impl.index_cache.prefix: metadata[sharded] for impl in impls}
+        with set_forward_context(md, config):
+            for impl, query in zip(impls, queries):
+                impl(
+                    query
+                    if sharded
+                    else query[
+                        :, rank * local_heads : (rank + 1) * local_heads
+                    ].contiguous()
+                )
+
+    def check_local(metadata, queries, num_tokens):
+        run(False, metadata, queries)
+        for reference, sharded in zip(*(impls[:active_layers] for impls in layers)):
+            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                sharded.topk_indices_buffer[:num_tokens].sort(dim=-1).values,
+                reference.topk_indices_buffer[:num_tokens].sort(dim=-1).values,
+                rtol=0,
+                atol=0,
+            )
+        if (
+            metadata[1].prefill_msa is not None
+            and metadata[1].prefill_msa.local_chunks is None
+        ):
+            nd = metadata[1].num_decode_tokens
+            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                metadata[1].unified_scores[nd:],
+                metadata[0].unified_scores[nd:],
+                rtol=0,
+                atol=0,
+            )
+        assert comm.errors.item() == 0
+        assert torch.count_nonzero(comm.recv[..., 32]).item() == 0
+        if (
+            metadata[1].prefill_msa is None
+            and active_layers > 1
+            and comm.tagged_enabled
+        ):
+            tags = (comm.tagged_recv[..., :num_tokens, :] >> 32) & 0xFFFFFFFF
+            generations = comm.expected_generations[:, None, :, :num_tokens, None]
+            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                tags, (generations.long() & 0xFFFFFFFF).expand_as(tags)
+            )
+
+    def check(metadata, queries, num_tokens):
+        error = None
+        try:
+            check_local(metadata, queries, num_tokens)
+        except AssertionError as failure:
+            error = failure
+        # No rank starts publishing the next phase before every snapshot completes.
+        ok = torch.tensor([int(error is None)], dtype=torch.int32, device="cpu")
+        torch.distributed.all_reduce(
+            ok, op=torch.distributed.ReduceOp.MIN, group=comm.group.cpu_group
+        )
+        if not ok.item():
+            raise AssertionError(
+                f"Indexer validation failed on a TP rank: {error}"
+            ) from error
+
+    exchanges = []
+    all_to_all = torch.distributed.all_to_all_single
+
+    def exchange(received, send, **kwargs):
+        exchanges.append(tuple(send.shape))
+        return all_to_all(received, send, **kwargs)
+
+    batches = [
+        BatchSpec(seq_lens=[129, 2305], query_lens=[1, 1]),
+        BatchSpec(seq_lens=[128, 2306], query_lens=[4, 4]),
+        BatchSpec(seq_lens=[128, 2307], query_lens=[8, 8]),
+        BatchSpec(seq_lens=[2305, 2561, 2691, 2720], query_lens=[1, 1, 1027, 127]),
+        BatchSpec(seq_lens=[2308, 2564, 2691, 2720], query_lens=[4, 4, 1027, 127]),
+        BatchSpec(seq_lens=[2305, 2562, 2691, 2720], query_lens=[1, 2, 3, 4]),
+        BatchSpec(seq_lens=[2691], query_lens=[1027]),
+        BatchSpec(seq_lens=[129, 2305], query_lens=[1, 1]),
+    ]
+    for batch, active_layers in zip(batches, (5, 2, 1, 5, 5, 2, 1, 5), strict=True):
+        # Exercise wrap-safe rotation, single-layer ACK fallback and mixed transitions.
+        comm.num_layers = active_layers
+        common = create_common_attn_metadata(
+            batch, page_size, device, arange_block_indices=True
+        )
+        num_pages = common.block_table_tensor.numel()
+        common.block_table_tensor = torch.randperm(num_pages, device=device)[
+            common.block_table_tensor.long()
+        ].int()
+        # Runtime tables keep their configured width across batches.
+        table_width = (config.model_config.max_model_len + page_size - 1) // page_size
+        common.block_table_tensor = torch.nn.functional.pad(
+            common.block_table_tensor,
+            (0, table_width - common.block_table_tensor.shape[1]),
+        )
+        if len(set(batch.query_lens)) > 1:
+            # Shared prefix pages must retain each request's logical order.
+            common.block_table_tensor[-1, :8] = common.block_table_tensor[-2, :8]
+        common.positions = torch.cat(
+            [
+                torch.arange(s - q, s, device=device)
+                for s, q in zip(batch.seq_lens, batch.query_lens)
+            ]
+        )
+        num_tokens = batch.compute_num_tokens()
+        bits = torch.arange(7, device=device)
+        blocks_per_page = page_size // 128
+        num_blocks = num_pages * blocks_per_page
+        assert num_blocks <= 1 << bits.numel()
+        page_codes = (
+            (torch.arange(num_blocks, device=device)[:, None] >> bits) & 1
+        ) * 64
+        head_codes = torch.tensor([0, 21, 42, 85], device=device)[:, None]
+        queries, caches = [], []
+        for layer, (reference, sharded) in enumerate(zip(*layers)):
+            # Logical B128 codes keep P256 half-pages distinct at the cutoff.
+            cache = torch.randint(-4, 5, (num_pages, page_size, 128), device=device)
+            cache.view(num_pages, blocks_per_page, 128, 128)[..., :7] = page_codes.view(
+                num_pages, blocks_per_page, 1, 7
+            )
+            cache = cache.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+            reference.index_cache.bind_kv_cache(cache.unsqueeze(1))
+            shard = local_shard(cache).contiguous()
+            sharded.index_cache.bind_kv_cache(
+                shard.view(num_pages, 1, page_size, 128 // world)
+            )
+            caches.append(cache)
+            query = (
+                torch.randint(-2, 3, (num_tokens, 4, 128), device=device).float() / 64
+            )
+            query[:, :, :7] = (1 << bits) * (
+                1 - 2 * (((head_codes ^ (layer * 7)) >> bits) & 1)
+            )
+            query[PREFILL_CHUNK_SIZE:] *= -1
+            queries.append(query.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn))
+        metadata = [builder.build(0, common) for builder in builders]
+        for md, storage in zip(metadata[2:], prefill_storage, strict=True):
+            assert md.unified_scores is None
+            if md.prefill_msa is not None:
+                prefill = md.prefill_msa
+                assert (
+                    prefill.local_scores.untyped_storage().data_ptr(),
+                    prefill.candidate_buffers.untyped_storage().data_ptr(),
+                ) == storage
+                assert all(arm.is_contiguous() for arm in prefill.candidate_buffers)
+        expected_decode = {
+            (4, 4, 1027, 127): (2, 8),
+            (1, 2, 3, 4): (1, 1),
+        }.get(tuple(batch.query_lens))
+        if expected_decode is not None:
+            assert all(
+                (md.num_decodes, md.num_decode_tokens) == expected_decode
+                for md in metadata
+            )
+
+        # Compile before capture. No host assertion/barrier between layers or
+        # repeated steps: those would hide receive-slot reuse races.
+        run(False, metadata, queries)
+        for _ in range(3):
+            run(True, metadata, queries)
+        check(metadata, queries, num_tokens)
+
+        if metadata[1].prefill_msa is None:
+            for decode_metadata in metadata[1:]:
+                metadata[1] = decode_metadata
+                run(True, metadata, queries)
+                graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+                with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+                    run(True, metadata, queries)
+                for _ in range(3):
+                    for query, cache, impl in zip(queries, caches, layers[1]):
+                        query.copy_((-query.float()).to(query.dtype))
+                        cache.view(torch.uint8).copy_(
+                            cache.view(torch.uint8).roll(1, 0)
+                        )
+                        impl.index_cache.kv_cache.copy_(local_shard(cache))
+                    graph.replay()
+                check(metadata, queries, num_tokens)
+        else:
+            for local_metadata in metadata[2:]:
+                metadata[1] = local_metadata
+                prefill = local_metadata.prefill_msa
+                scratch = prefill.local_scores
+                assert scratch.shape[0] <= PREFILL_CHUNK_SIZE
+                assert scratch.numel() * scratch.element_size() <= PREFILL_SCORE_BYTES
+                chunks = prefill.local_chunks
+                assert chunks[0].start == 0
+                assert chunks[-1].end == prefill.candidate_buffers.shape[2]
+                if chunks[-1].end > PREFILL_CHUNK_SIZE:
+                    assert len(chunks) > 1
+                assert all(chunk.plan is not None for chunk in chunks)
+                # Both dispatches reuse scratch across layers and steps; unified
+                # mixed scoring exchanges decode and prefill candidates together.
+                exchanges.clear()
+                with pytest.MonkeyPatch.context() as patch:
+                    patch.setattr(torch.distributed, "all_to_all_single", exchange)
+                    for _ in range(3):
+                        run(True, metadata, queries)
+                exchanged_tokens = (
+                    num_tokens if prefill.unified else local_metadata.num_prefill_tokens
+                )
+                assert exchanges == [(world, local_heads, exchanged_tokens, 33)] * (
+                    3 * active_layers
+                )
+                check(metadata, queries, num_tokens)
+            pages = torch.tensor([num_pages - 1, 0, 7, 0], device=device)
+            gathered = [
+                msa.gather_prefill_pages(
+                    impl.index_cache.kv_cache, pages, comm, page_size=page_size
+                )
+                for impl in layers[1]
+            ]
+            for actual, cache in zip(gathered, caches):
+                expected = cache.view(torch.uint8).index_select(0, pages)
+                assert torch.equal(actual.view(torch.uint8), expected)
+
+            # NVFP4 shard pages hold this rank's codes, then its scales; they
+            # reassemble as the e4m3 pages the unsharded NVFP4 prefill stages.
+            cpu = torch.Generator().manual_seed(page_size)
+            codes = torch.randint(0, 256, (num_pages, page_size, 64), generator=cpu)
+            codes = codes.to(torch.uint8).to(device)
+            scales = torch.rand(num_pages, page_size, 8, generator=cpu) * 448
+            scales = scales.to(device).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+            rows = page_size // world
+            owned = (
+                slice(rank * rows, (rank + 1) * rows)
+                if page_size == 256
+                else slice(rank, None, world)
+            )
+            shard = torch.cat(
+                (
+                    codes[:, owned].flatten(1),
+                    scales[:, owned].view(torch.uint8).flatten(1),
+                ),
+                dim=1,
+            ).view(num_pages, rows, 72)
+            actual = msa.gather_prefill_pages(shard, pages, comm, page_size=page_size)
+            expected = _nvfp4_rows_to_fp8(codes, scales).index_select(0, pages)
+            assert actual.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn
+            assert torch.equal(actual.view(torch.uint8), expected.view(torch.uint8))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.timeout(600)
+@pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100),
+    reason="MiniMax M3 sharded MSA indexer requires SM100",
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tp_size", [2, 4])
+def test_msa_indexer_tp_matches_replicated(monkeypatch, tp_size):
+    """Real TP score/TopK, both prefill paths, and decode graph replay."""
+    if torch.accelerator.device_count() < tp_size:
+        pytest.skip(f"Requires {tp_size} GPUs")
+    if not all(
+        torch.cuda.can_device_access_peer(src, dst)
+        for src in range(tp_size)
+        for dst in range(tp_size)
+        if src != dst
+    ):
+        pytest.skip("Requires peer access between all TP GPUs")
+    multi_process_parallel(monkeypatch, tp_size, 1, _indexer_sharding)
+
+
+def _check_sharding_policy(config, original_comm):
+    from vllm.models.minimax_m3.nvidia import indexer_msa as msa
+
+    sparse_config = config.model_config.hf_text_config.sparse_attention_config
+    policy = create_vllm_config(
+        tensor_parallel_size=original_comm.world,
+        block_size=128,
+        max_model_len=4096,
+        max_num_seqs=32,
+        hf_config_override={"sparse_attention_config": sparse_config},
+    )
+    model = copy(policy.model_config)
+    for mode, length, cap, active_cap, q, eager, graph_mode, expected in [
+        ("on", 4096, 1, None, 4, False, CUDAGraphMode.FULL, original_comm.world),
+        ("off", 1024 * 1024, 32, None, 1, False, CUDAGraphMode.FULL, 1),
+        ("on", 4096, 1, None, 1, True, CUDAGraphMode.NONE, original_comm.world),
+        ("off", 1024 * 1024, 32, None, 1, True, CUDAGraphMode.NONE, 1),
+    ]:
+        policy.model_config = copy(model)
+        policy.model_config.max_model_len = length
+        policy.model_config.enforce_eager = eager
+        policy.scheduler_config = SchedulerConfig(

+    values = grid[nibbles & 7] * torch.where(nibbles >= 8, -1.0, 1.0)
+    group_scales = scales.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn).float()
+    values = (values.unflatten(-1, (8, 16)) * group_scales[..., None]).flatten(-2)
+    if not round_e4m3:
+        return values
+    return values.clamp(-448.0, 448.0).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn).float()

+def _nvfp4_shard_pages(codes, scales, rank, world, page_size, pitch_pad):
+    """This rank's ``[pages, ROWS, 72]`` shard pages: codes, then scales."""
+    num_pages = codes.shape[0]
+    rows = page_size // world
+    if page_size == 256:
+        owned = slice(rank * rows, (rank + 1) * rows)
+    else:
+        owned = slice(rank, None, world)
+    pitch = rows * 72 + pitch_pad
+    pages = torch.full((num_pages, pitch), 0xFF, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    pages[:, : rows * 64] = codes[:, owned].reshape(num_pages, -1)
+    pages[:, rows * 64 : rows * 72] = scales[:, owned].reshape(num_pages, -1)
+    return pages.as_strided((num_pages, rows, 72), (pitch, 72, 1))

+def _warm_up_q8kv4_scores(
+    wrapper_cls: Any, num_heads: int, device: torch.device

+    """Compile the Q8KV4 decode score kernel before a CUDA graph captures it.
+
+    MSA refuses to compile during capture, and the mixed-batch warmup decodes
+    one query per request, which never takes this path. The compiled kernel
+    is keyed by device and head count, not shapes, so one empty plan (eight
+    query slots on page 0: no history page) builds it."""

+    if key in _Q8KV4_WARM:
+        return
+    wrapper = wrapper_cls(num_heads=num_heads)
+    wrapper.plan(
+        torch.zeros((1, 1), dtype=torch.int32, device=device),
+        torch.full((1,), Q8KV4_QUERY_LEN, dtype=torch.int32, device=device),
+    )

+        torch.zeros(
+            (Q8KV4_QUERY_LEN, num_heads, 128),
+            dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn,
+            device=device,
+        ),
+        torch.zeros((1, PAGE_SIZE, NVFP4_ROW_BYTES), dtype=torch.uint8, device=device),

+    @cute.jit
+    def store_page_maxima(
+        self,
+        rC: cute.Tensor,  # [4, ROWS // 16, Q_TILES] m16n8 accumulators
+        epi_buffer: cute.Tensor,
+        scores: cute.Tensor,
+        batch_id,
+        super_id,
+        warp_id,
+        lane_id,
+        q_start,
+        decode_query_len,
+        rank,
+    ):
+        """Mask, reduce this warp's shard page to B128 maxima, and store them."""
+        ROWS = self.page_size // self.world_size
+        Q_TILES = cute.ceil_div(self.num_heads * self.max_decode_query_len, 8)
+        k_base = self.page_k_base(super_id, warp_id, rank)
+        rMax = cute.make_rmem_tensor((2, Q_TILES), Float32)
+        rMax.fill(float("-inf"))
+        for m in cutlass.range_constexpr(ROWS // 16):
+            self.fold_tile_maxima(rC[None, m, None], rMax, m, lane_id, k_base, q_start)
+        self.store_maxima(
+            rMax,
+            epi_buffer,
+            scores,
+            batch_id,
+            super_id,
+            warp_id,
+            lane_id,
+            decode_query_len,
+        )
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def page_k_base(self, super_id, warp_id, rank):
+        """Token position of this warp's first shard row."""
+        tile = super_id * self.PAGES + warp_id
+        # P128 interleaves rows; P256 assigns contiguous rank slices.
+        k_base = tile * self.page_size + rank
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.page_size == 256):
+            k_base = tile * self.page_size + rank * (self.page_size // self.world_size)
+        return k_base
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def fold_tile_maxima(
+        self,
+        rC_m: cute.Tensor,  # [4, Q_TILES] m16n8 accumulators of rows 16m..16m+15
+        rMax: cute.Tensor,  # [2, Q_TILES] running maxima of this lane's columns
+        m,
+        lane_id,
+        k_base,
+        q_start,
+    ):
+        """Causally mask a 16-row tile and fold it into the page maxima."""
+        MAX_DQL = self.max_decode_query_len
+        TP = self.world_size
+        Q_TILES = cute.ceil_div(self.num_heads * MAX_DQL, 8)
+        for q in cutlass.range_constexpr(Q_TILES):
+            for v in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                # Accumulator v is row 8 * (v // 2) + lane // 4, column v % 2.
+                i = m * 2 + v // 2
+                j = v % 2
+                col = q * 8 + (lane_id % 4) * 2 + j
+                q_pos = q_start + col % MAX_DQL
+                k_pos = k_base + (i * 8 + lane_id // 4) * TP
+                if cutlass.const_expr(self.page_size == 256):
+                    k_pos = k_base + i * 8 + lane_id // 4
+                rC_m[v, q] = rC_m[v, q] if q_pos >= k_pos else float("-inf")
+                rMax[j, q] = cute.arch.fmax(rMax[j, q], rC_m[v, q])
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def store_maxima(
+        self,
+        rMax: cute.Tensor,  # [2, Q_TILES] per-lane page maxima
+        epi_buffer: cute.Tensor,
+        scores: cute.Tensor,
+        batch_id,
+        super_id,
+        warp_id,
+        lane_id,
+        decode_query_len,
+    ):
+        """Reduce page maxima across the warp's rows and store each B128 block."""
+        MAX_DQL = self.max_decode_query_len
+        BLOCK_Q = self.num_heads * MAX_DQL
+        PAGES = self.PAGES
+        MMA_N = 8
+        Q_TILES = cute.ceil_div(BLOCK_Q, MMA_N)
+
+        for q in cutlass.range_constexpr(Q_TILES):
+            # warp-reduction among lanes 0,4,8,12,...
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(3):
+                offset = 4 << i
+                other0 = cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(
+                    rMax[0, q], offset=offset, mask=-1, mask_and_clamp=31
+                )
+                other1 = cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(
+                    rMax[1, q], offset=offset, mask=-1, mask_and_clamp=31
+                )
+                rMax[0, q] = cute.arch.fmax(rMax[0, q], other0)
+                rMax[1, q] = cute.arch.fmax(rMax[1, q], other1)
+
+            # lanes 0..3 hold columns q * 8 + 2 * lane + {0, 1}
+            if lane_id * 2 < MMA_N:
+                epi_buffer[q * MMA_N + lane_id * 2 + 0, warp_id] = rMax[0, q]
+                epi_buffer[q * MMA_N + lane_id * 2 + 1, warp_id] = rMax[1, q]
+        cute.arch.barrier(barrier_id=self.BAR_MMA, number_of_threads=128)
+
+        # Padded pages are -inf.
+        if warp_id == 0 and lane_id < BLOCK_Q:
+            head_id = lane_id // MAX_DQL
+            q_local_pos = lane_id - head_id * MAX_DQL
+            if q_local_pos < decode_query_len:
+                t = batch_id * decode_query_len + q_local_pos
+                for p in cutlass.range_constexpr(PAGES):
+                    block_id = super_id * PAGES + p

+    @cache
+    @staticmethod

+class IndexDecodeScoreShardedNvfp4Kernel(IndexDecodeScoreShardedKernel):
+    """FP8 Q against NVFP4 shard pages of M3.1's index cache.
+
+    A shard page holds this rank's rows of an NVFP4 index page:
+    ``[ROWS x 64 B e2m1 codes][ROWS x 8 B e4m3 group scales]``, the low nibble
+    the even dim and one scale per 16 dims. With ``round_k`` each K value is
+    rounded once to e4m3, as the SM100/SM103 Q8KV4 decode indexer scores it;
+    without it K keeps the exact e2m1 x scale product, as on SM107. K is fed
+    as FP16 to the same ``mma.sync`` as the FP8 kernel. ldmatrix gives each
+    lane eight consecutive codes per 16 B row slice, so every lane reads the
+    matching eight Q bytes itself instead of ldmatrix-loading Q.
+    """
+
+    DATA_BYTES = 64
+    SCALE_BYTES = 8
+
+    def __init__(self, *args, round_k: bool = True, **kw):
+        super().__init__(*args, **kw)
+        self.round_k = round_k
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        gQ: cute.Tensor,  # [bs * runtime_decode_query_len, num_heads, head_dim]
+        gK_data: cute.Tensor,  # [num_pages, ROWS, 64] uint8, page pitch strided
+        gK_scale: cute.Tensor,  # [num_pages, ROWS // 2, 16] uint8, two rows each
+        block_table: cute.Tensor,  # [bs, max_pages]
+        scores: cute.Tensor,  # [total_tokens, num_heads, score_columns]
+        seq_lens: cute.Tensor,  # [bs]
+        rank: Int32,  # this rank's token offset inside every block
+        stream: CUstream,
+    ):
+        dtype = self.dtype
+        num_heads = self.num_heads
+        head_dim = self.head_dim
+        num_stages = self.num_stages
+        MAX_DQL = self.max_decode_query_len
+        BLOCK_Q = num_heads * MAX_DQL
+        ROWS = self.page_size // self.world_size
+        DATA = self.DATA_BYTES
+        assert BLOCK_Q <= 32
+        assert head_dim == 2 * DATA
+
+        batch = seq_lens.shape[0]
+        decode_query_len = gQ.shape[0] // batch
+        grid = (batch, self.split_k, 1)
+        block = (32 * 5, 1, 1)
+
+        tma_g2s = cpasync.CopyBulkTensorTileG2SOp()
+        elems = 128 * 8 // dtype.width
+
+        sQ_layout = cute.make_layout(
+            (MAX_DQL, num_heads, (elems, head_dim // elems)),
+            stride=(elems, MAX_DQL * elems, (1, BLOCK_Q * elems)),
+        )
+        sQ_layout = cute.make_composed_layout(cute.make_swizzle(3, 4, 3), 0, sQ_layout)
+        Q_tma = cpasync.make_tiled_tma_atom(
+            tma_g2s,
+            cute.logical_divide(gQ, (None, None, elems)),
+            sQ_layout,
+            cta_tiler=(MAX_DQL, num_heads, head_dim),
+        )
+
+        # 64 B code rows take the 64 B swizzle, so ldmatrix is conflict-free.
+        sK_layout = cute.make_layout(
+            (1, ROWS, (DATA, 1), self.PAGES * num_stages),
+            stride=(0, DATA, (1, ROWS * DATA), ROWS * DATA),
+        )
+        sK_layout = cute.make_composed_layout(cute.make_swizzle(2, 4, 3), 0, sK_layout)
+        K_tma = cpasync.make_tiled_tma_atom(
+            tma_g2s,
+            cute.logical_divide(gK_data, (None, None, DATA)),
+            sK_layout,
+            cta_tiler=(1, ROWS, DATA),
+        )

+            (1, ROWS // 2, 16, self.PAGES * num_stages),
+            stride=(0, 16, 1, ROWS * self.SCALE_BYTES),

+            Q_tma,
+            K_tma,
+            S_tma,
+            block_table,
+            scores,
+            seq_lens,
+            decode_query_len,
+            rank,

+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(
+        self,
+        Q_tma: cpasync.TmaInfo,
+        K_tma: cpasync.TmaInfo,
+        S_tma: cpasync.TmaInfo,
+        block_table: cute.Tensor,
+        scores: cute.Tensor,
+        seq_lens: cute.Tensor,
+        decode_query_len,
+        rank,
+    ):

+        lane_id = cute.arch.lane_idx()
+
+        NUM_HEADS = self.num_heads
+        MAX_DQL = self.max_decode_query_len

+        PAGES = self.PAGES

+        DATA = self.DATA_BYTES
+        SCALE = self.SCALE_BYTES
+        head_dim = self.head_dim
+        dtype = self.dtype
+        MMA_N = 8
+        num_stages = self.num_stages

+                cpasync.prefetch_descriptor(K_tma.atom)
+                cpasync.prefetch_descriptor(S_tma.atom)
+            cute.arch.sync_threads()
+
+            if cutlass.const_expr(self.prefetch_history):  # noqa: SIM102

+                    if warp_id == 4:

+                            cute.arch.mbarrier_arrive_and_expect_tx(
+                                tma_full_mbar + 1, PAGES * page_bytes

+                        for p in cutlass.range_constexpr(PAGES):
+                            page_id = block_table[batch_id, split_id * PAGES + p]
+                            simple_tma_copy(
+                                K_tma.atom,
+                                K_tma.tma_tensor[page_id, None, None],
+                                sK[None, None, None, PAGES + p],
+                                tma_full_mbar + 1,
+                                cache_policy=EVICT_FIRST,
+                            )

+def nvfp4_shard_views(
+    index_kv_shard: torch.Tensor,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Split ``[pages, ROWS, 72]`` uint8 shard pages into code and scale views.
+
+    A page is ``ROWS x 64`` code bytes, then ``ROWS x 8`` scale bytes; the page
+    pitch may exceed ``ROWS * 72``. Returns ``[pages, ROWS, 64]`` codes and
+    ``[pages, ROWS // 2, 16]`` scales, two token rows per 16 B.
+    """
+    pages, rows, width = index_kv_shard.shape
+    data = IndexDecodeScoreShardedNvfp4Kernel.DATA_BYTES
+    scale = IndexDecodeScoreShardedNvfp4Kernel.SCALE_BYTES
+    pitch = index_kv_shard.stride(0)
+    if (
+        index_kv_shard.dtype != torch.uint8
+        or width != data + scale
+        or index_kv_shard.stride(2) != 1
+        or index_kv_shard.stride(1) != width
+        or pitch < rows * width
+        or pitch % 16
+        or index_kv_shard.data_ptr() % 16
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "NVFP4 shard pages must be 16 B-aligned uint8 [pages, ROWS, 72] views"
+        )
+    offset = index_kv_shard.storage_offset()
+    codes = index_kv_shard.as_strided((pages, rows, data), (pitch, data, 1), offset)
+    scales = index_kv_shard.as_strided(
+        (pages, rows // 2, 2 * scale), (pitch, 2 * scale, 1), offset + rows * data
+    )
+    return codes, scales
+

+@cache
+def nvfp4_k_rounds_to_e4m3(device_index: int) -> bool:
+    """Whether the stock Q8KV4 decode indexer rounds NVFP4 K to e4m3 here.
+
+    SM100/SM103 round each e2m1 x scale product once to e4m3 for an FP8 MMA;
+    SM107 has no QMUL4 and keeps the exact FP16 product (MSA #41).
+    """
+    return not current_platform.is_device_capability(107, device_index)

+def minimax_m3_index_decode_score_sharded_cutedsl(
+    idx_q: torch.Tensor,
+    index_kv_shard: torch.Tensor,
+    block_table: torch.Tensor,
+    seq_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    rank: int,
+    decode_query_len: int,
+    max_decode_query_len: int,
+    score_out: torch.Tensor,
+    split_k: int = DEFAULT_SPLIT_K,
+    *,
+    page_size: int = 128,
+    world_size: int | None = None,
+    use_pdl: bool = False,
+    prefetch_history: bool = False,
+    nvfp4_round_k: bool | None = None,
+) -> None:
+    """Write B128 maxima for interleaved P128 or contiguous P256 shards.
+
+    ``index_kv_shard`` is FP8 ``[pages, ROWS, 128]`` or, for NVFP4 index
+    caches, uint8 ``[pages, ROWS, 72]`` pages (see ``nvfp4_shard_views``).
+    History prefetch requires metadata fenced by a non-PDL cache writer.
+    NVFP4 K is rounded to e4m3 where the stock decode indexer rounds it, unless
+    ``nvfp4_round_k`` says otherwise.
+    """
+    nvfp4 = index_kv_shard.dtype == torch.uint8
+    if idx_q.dtype != torch.float8_e4m3fn or not (
+        nvfp4 or index_kv_shard.dtype == idx_q.dtype
+    ):
+        raise TypeError("sharded index decode score needs FP8 Q and FP8 or NVFP4 K")
+    total_tokens, num_heads, head_dim = idx_q.shape
+    batch = block_table.shape[0]
+    assert page_size in (128, 256)
+    if world_size is None:
+        world_size = page_size // index_kv_shard.shape[1]
+    assert world_size in SUPPORTED_TP
+    assert index_kv_shard.shape[1] == page_size // world_size
+    assert total_tokens == batch * decode_query_len
+    assert 1 <= decode_query_len <= max_decode_query_len
+    assert num_heads * max_decode_query_len <= 32
+    assert 0 <= rank < world_size and num_heads % world_size == 0
+    assert score_out.ndim == 3 and score_out.shape[:2] == (total_tokens, num_heads)
+    score_columns = score_out.shape[-1]
+    assert 0 < score_columns <= MAX_K_TILES
+    assert score_columns % IndexDecodeScoreShardedKernel.PAGES == 0
+    assert score_out.dtype == torch.float32 and score_out.is_contiguous()
+    kernel_cls = (
+        IndexDecodeScoreShardedNvfp4Kernel if nvfp4 else IndexDecodeScoreShardedKernel
+    )
+    # The NVFP4 kernel also compiles in how it rounds K.
+    nvfp4_args: tuple[bool, ...] = ()
+    if nvfp4:
+        if nvfp4_round_k is None:
+            nvfp4_round_k = nvfp4_k_rounds_to_e4m3(index_kv_shard.device.index)
+        nvfp4_args = (nvfp4_round_k,)
+    kernel = kernel_cls.compile(
+        num_heads,
+        max_decode_query_len,
+        split_k,
+        head_dim,
+        world_size,
+        page_size,
+        use_pdl,
+        prefetch_history,
+        score_columns,
+        *nvfp4_args,
+    )
+    if nvfp4:
+        codes, scales = nvfp4_shard_views(index_kv_shard)
+        kernel(idx_q, codes, scales, block_table, score_out, seq_lens, rank)
+    else:
+        kernel(idx_q, index_kv_shard, block_table, score_out, seq_lens, rank)

+@triton.jit
+def _index_k_load_tagged_word(ptr):
+    return tl.inline_asm_elementwise(
+        "ld.relaxed.sys.u64 $0, [$1];",
+        "=l,l",
+        [ptr],
+        dtype=tl.uint64,
+        is_pure=False,
+        pack=1,
+    )

+@triton.jit
+def _index_k_merge_candidates_kernel(
+    recv_ptr,
+    valid_ptr,
+    out_ptr,
+    out_stride_t,
+    out_stride_h,
+    valid_stride,
+    err_ptr,
+    recv_stride_src,
+    recv_stride_h,
+    recv_stride_t,
+    expected_generations,
+    tokens,
+    TAGGED: tl.constexpr,
+    PREFILL: tl.constexpr,
+    ROWS: tl.constexpr,
+    W: tl.constexpr,
+    INIT: tl.constexpr,
+    LOCAL: tl.constexpr,
+    MAX_TILES: tl.constexpr,
+    SPIN: tl.constexpr,
+    launch_pdl: tl.constexpr,
+):

+        if launch_pdl:
+            tl.extra.cuda.gdc_launch_dependents()
+        end = tl.cdiv(tokens, ROWS)
+        stride = tl.num_programs(0)
+    else:
+        end = tl.program_id(0) + 1
+        stride = 1
+    for tile in range(tl.program_id(0), end, stride):
+        if ROWS > 1:
+            t = tile * ROWS + tl.arange(0, ROWS)[:, None]
+            k = tl.arange(0, W * 16)[None, :]
+        else:
+            t = tile
+            k = tl.arange(0, W * 16)
+        h = tl.program_id(1)

+        source = row + k // 16 * recv_stride_src + k % 16
+        if TAGGED and ROWS > 1:
+            source = source - tl.maximum(t - (tokens - 1), 0) * recv_stride_t
+        if PREFILL:
+            ids = tl.load(source + 16, mask=t < tokens, other=-1)
+            scores = tl.load(source, mask=t < tokens, other=0).to(
+                tl.float32, bitcast=True
+            )
+            pending = 0
+        elif TAGGED:
+            counter = expected_generations + h * (recv_stride_h // recv_stride_t) + t
+            generation = tl.load(counter, mask=t < tokens, other=0).to(tl.uint32) + 1
+            generation = tl.where(generation == 0, 1, generation).to(tl.uint32)
+            pending, spins = 1, 0
+            score_words = tl.full(
+                (ROWS, W * 16) if ROWS > 1 else (W * 16,), 0, tl.uint64
+            )

+                score_words = _index_k_load_tagged_word(source)
+                id_words = _index_k_load_tagged_word(source + 16)
+                matches = ((score_words >> 32) == generation) & (

+                if ROWS > 1:
+                    pending = tl.sum(
+                        tl.sum((~matches & (t < tokens)).to(tl.int32), 1), 0
+                    )
+                else:
+                    pending = tl.sum((~matches).to(tl.int32), 0)
+                spins += 1

+            scores = score_words.to(tl.uint32).to(tl.float32, bitcast=True)
+        else:
+            ready = row + tl.arange(0, W) * recv_stride_src + 32
+            seen = tl.atomic_add(ready, 0, sem="acquire", scope="sys")
+            pending = tl.sum((seen != 1).to(tl.int32), 0)
+            spins = 0
+            while (pending > 0) & (spins < SPIN):
+                seen = tl.atomic_add(ready, 0, sem="acquire", scope="sys")
+                pending = tl.sum((seen != 1).to(tl.int32), 0)
+                spins += 1
+            ids = tl.load(source + 16)
+            scores = tl.load(source).to(tl.float32, bitcast=True)
+        if pending > 0:
+            tl.atomic_add(err_ptr, 1)
+            tl.inline_asm_elementwise(
+                "trap; mov.u32 $0, 0;", "=r", [], dtype=tl.int32, is_pure=False, pack=1
+            )
+        if ROWS > 1:
+            nvalid = tl.minimum(
+                tl.load(valid_ptr + t * valid_stride, mask=t < tokens, other=0),
+                MAX_TILES,
+            )
+        else:
+            nvalid = tl.minimum(tl.load(valid_ptr + t * valid_stride), MAX_TILES)
+        valid = (ids >= 0) & (ids < nvalid)
+        scores = tl.where(scores == scores, scores, -float("inf"))
+        if W != 2:
+            equal = (ids[:, None] == ids[None, :]) & valid[:, None] & valid[None, :]
+            scores = tl.max(tl.where(equal, scores[None, :], -float("inf")), 1)
+            first = tl.min(tl.where(equal, k[None, :], W * 16), 1)
+            unique = valid & (k == first)
+        forced = (ids < INIT) | (ids >= tl.maximum(0, nvalid - LOCAL))
+        scores = tl.where(forced, float("inf"), scores)

+        bits = tl.where(scores == 0, 0.0, scores).to(tl.uint32, bitcast=True)
+        ordered = tl.where((bits & 0x80000000) != 0, ~bits, bits ^ 0x80000000)
+        if W == 2:
+            # One candidate per lane; retain the maximum on the first matching lane.
+            ordered, leader = tl.inline_asm_elementwise(
+                """{
+                    .reg .b32 peers, reversed, first, lane;
+                    .reg .pred p;

+                    redux.sync.max.u32 $0, $3, peers;
+                    brev.b32 reversed, peers;
+                    clz.b32 first, reversed;
+                    mov.u32 lane, %laneid;
+                    setp.eq.u32 p, lane, first;
+                    selp.u32 $1, 1, 0, p;
+                }""",
+                constraints="=r,=r,r,r",
+                args=[ids, ordered],
+                dtype=(tl.uint32, tl.int32),
+                is_pure=True,
+                pack=1,
+            )
+            unique = valid & (leader != 0)
+        keys = (ordered.to(tl.uint64) << 32) | (0xFFFFFFFF - ids.to(tl.uint32)).to(
+            tl.uint64
+        )
+        keys = tl.where(unique, keys, 0)
+        keys = tl.sort(keys, descending=True)
+        if ROWS > 1:
+            positions = tl.broadcast_to(tl.arange(0, 16)[None, :], (ROWS, 16))
+            selected_keys = tl.gather(keys, positions, 1)
+        else:
+            positions = tl.arange(0, 16)
+            selected_keys = tl.gather(keys, positions, 0)
+        selected = (0xFFFFFFFF - selected_keys.to(tl.uint32)).to(tl.int32)
+        selected = tl.where(selected_keys != 0, selected, 0x7FFFFFFF)
+        selected = tl.sort(selected, descending=False)
+        output = tl.where(selected == 0x7FFFFFFF, -1, selected)
+        if PREFILL:
+            # Keep graph-padding rows nonempty for downstream CSR construction.
+            output = tl.where((nvalid == 0) & (positions == 0), 0, output)

+            mask=t < tokens if PREFILL or ROWS > 1 else True,

+                tl.store(counter, generation, mask=t < tokens)
+            else:
+                tl.atomic_xchg(ready, 0, sem="release", scope="sys")
+    if launch_pdl:
+        # Do not let the next layer reuse scratch before this publisher exits.
+        tl.extra.cuda.gdc_wait()

+import torch

+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _indexer_metadata(
+    QueryStart,
+    SeqLens,
+    Positions,
+    Slots,
+    Context,
+    ValidPages,
+    IndexSlots,
+    num_reqs,
+    num_tokens,
+    num_slots,
+    rank: tl.constexpr,
+    tp: tl.constexpr,
+    PAGE_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    q0 = tl.load(QueryStart + row, row < num_reqs, other=0)
+    q1 = tl.load(QueryStart + row + 1, row < num_reqs, other=0)
+    seq = tl.load(SeqLens + row, row < num_reqs, other=0)
+    tl.store(Context + row, seq - (q1 - q0), row < num_reqs)
+    position = tl.load(Positions + row, row < num_tokens, other=-1)
+    slot = tl.load(Slots + row, row < num_slots, other=-1)
+    tl.store(
+        ValidPages + row,
+        tl.where((position >= 0) & (slot >= 0), position // 128 + 1, 0),
+        row < num_tokens,
+    )
+    offset = slot % PAGE_SIZE
+    if PAGE_SIZE == 256:
+        owner = offset // (PAGE_SIZE // tp)
+        local = offset % (PAGE_SIZE // tp)
+    else:
+        owner = offset % tp
+        local = offset // tp
+    sharded = slot // PAGE_SIZE * (PAGE_SIZE // tp) + local
+    tl.store(
+        IndexSlots + row,
+        tl.where((slot >= 0) & (owner == rank), sharded, -1),
+        row < num_slots,
+    )
+
+
+def prepare_indexer_metadata(
+    query_start: torch.Tensor,
+    seq_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    slots: torch.Tensor,
+    context: torch.Tensor,
+    valid_pages: torch.Tensor,
+    index_slots: torch.Tensor,
+    rank: int,
+    tp: int,
+    page_size: int,
+) -> None:
+    """Write stable index-K slots, causal page counts and prefix lengths on device."""
+    assert page_size in (128, 256) and tp in (2, 4)
+    assert slots.numel() <= index_slots.numel()
+    rows = max(seq_lens.numel(), slots.numel(), valid_pages.numel())
+    _indexer_metadata[(triton.cdiv(rows, 256),)](
+        query_start,
+        seq_lens,
+        positions,
+        slots,
+        context,
+        valid_pages,
+        index_slots,
+        seq_lens.numel(),
+        valid_pages.numel(),
+        slots.numel(),
+        rank,
+        tp,
+        page_size,
+        256,
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _q8kv4_shard_lengths(
+    SeqLens,
+    Lengths,
+    num_reqs,
+    INDEX_SCALE: tl.constexpr,
+    INDEX_OFFSET: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    request = tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    mask = request < num_reqs
+    seq = tl.load(SeqLens + request, mask, other=0)
+    # The last query's B128 page: the request's history page count.
+    history = tl.maximum(seq - 1, 0) // 128
+    # Shard columns c whose global page c * INDEX_SCALE + INDEX_OFFSET is
+    # history (non-negative operands, so // is exact floor division).
+    owned = tl.maximum(history - INDEX_OFFSET + INDEX_SCALE - 1, 0) // INDEX_SCALE
+    tl.store(Lengths + request, owned * 128 + 8, mask)
+
+
+def prepare_q8kv4_shard_lengths(
+    seq_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    lengths: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    index_scale: int,
+    index_offset: int,
+) -> None:
+    """Lengths that make the Q8KV4 decode indexer score every owned column.
+
+    The indexer scores ``(length - 1) // 128`` pages and stores a page only
+    below a query slot's own page ``(length - 8 + slot) // 128``. Handed
+    ``owned * 128 + 8``, all eight slots sit one page past the owned history
+    columns, so every one is scored and stored for every slot, uncausally;
+    zero-length (padding) requests score nothing. The real causal cut is the
+    candidate publish's, from the global page counts.
+    """
+    num_reqs = seq_lens.numel()
+    assert lengths.shape == (num_reqs,) and lengths.dtype == torch.int32
+    assert seq_lens.dtype == torch.int32 and num_reqs > 0
+    assert index_scale in (1, 2) and 0 <= index_offset < index_scale
+    _q8kv4_shard_lengths[(triton.cdiv(num_reqs, 256),)](
+        seq_lens,
+        lengths,
+        num_reqs,
+        index_scale,
+        index_offset,
+        256,
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _prefill_window_metadata(
+    QueryStart,
+    SeqLens,
+    Metadata,
+    stride,
+    num_reqs,
+    start,
+    end,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    request = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    mask = request < num_reqs
+    base = tl.load(QueryStart)
+    begin = tl.load(QueryStart + request, mask, other=0) - base
+    finish = tl.load(QueryStart + request + 1, mask, other=0) - base
+    local_begin = tl.minimum(tl.maximum(begin - start, 0), end - start)
+    local_end = tl.minimum(tl.maximum(finish - start, 0), end - start)
+    query_len = local_end - local_begin
+    prefix = tl.load(SeqLens + request, mask, other=0) - (finish - begin)
+    prefix += tl.minimum(tl.maximum(start - begin, 0), finish - begin)
+    seq_len = prefix + query_len
+    kv_end = tl.cumsum(tl.where(mask, seq_len, 0))
+    tl.store(Metadata + request, local_begin, mask)
+    tl.store(Metadata + stride + request, query_len, mask)
+    tl.store(Metadata + 2 * stride + request, seq_len, mask)
+    tl.store(Metadata + 3 * stride + request, prefix, mask)
+    tl.store(Metadata + 4 * stride + request, kv_end - seq_len, mask)
+    tl.store(Metadata + num_reqs, end - start)
+    tl.store(Metadata + 4 * stride + num_reqs, tl.sum(tl.where(mask, seq_len, 0)))
+
+
+def prepare_prefill_window(
+    query_start: torch.Tensor,
+    seq_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    start: int,
+    end: int,
+    metadata: torch.Tensor,
+) -> None:
+    """Clip a token window against all requests without reading device lengths."""
+    num_reqs = seq_lens.numel()
+    assert query_start.numel() == num_reqs + 1
+    assert metadata.shape[0] == 5 and metadata.shape[1] >= num_reqs + 1
+    _prefill_window_metadata[(1,)](
+        query_start,
+        seq_lens,
+        metadata,
+        metadata.stride(0),
+        num_reqs,
+        start,
+        end,
+        triton.next_power_of_2(num_reqs),
+    )
